review_evidence: README describes Lean transcriptions/formalizations from the Formalisms Every Computer Scientist Should Know course.
Class modules contain substantive results such as least/greatest fixed-point theorems, mergesort correctness, language/automata constructions, and auxiliary proofs.
The class-by-class layout is the authored formal corpus, not generated lecture scaffolding, so no path exclusion is lossless.
summary: Retain FECS-SK course formalizations: the chronological class modules contain distinct definitions and proofs across fixed points, algorithms, automata/formalisms, and related CS mathematics.
